chunks: Mu‘āwiyah ibn ‘Ammār narrated from Abū ‘Abdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
“It is disliked for the muhrim to pass his garment above his nose, and there is no harm in the muhrim extending his garment until it reaches his nose.”

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection
key_terms.لِلْمُحْرِمِ: for the person in the state of ihram
key_terms.يُكْرَهُ: it is considered disliked in legal ruling

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a muhrim covering the nose with a garment?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the conduct of a person in ihram. It states that covering above the nose with one's garment is disliked, while extending the garment up to the nose itself is permitted.
